preconditions.description: The input S must be a string.
The length of S must be between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S contains only lowercase English alphabet characters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len({S[:i] + S[j] + S[i+1:j] + S[i] + S[j+1:] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S))})

postconditions.description: The return value is the count of distinct strings obtained by swapping exactly one pair of characters at distinct indices i and j (where i < j) in the input string S.
